task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to unlock the cuboid portal within the basement with the cuboid passkey. And then, ensure that the cuboid portal is open. After that, head south. With that over with, make sure that the hatch inside the workshop is unlocked with the latchkey. After that, look and see that the hatch inside the workshop is wide open. After that, move south. Following that, ensure that the gate inside the spare room is open. And then, take a trip west. Then, open the passageway in the canteen. Once you have pulled open the passageway, go west. Then, attempt to head north. Once you finish that, take a trip west. And then, try to go to the north. With that done, venture west. And then, go to the north. With that over with, move north. Following that, make an attempt to venture east. Then, recover the key from the floor of the playroom. Alright, thanks!
